doc: The main views of the API, as `GET /api/installations`, `/api/devices` and `/api/rooms` give them. `tests/views.rs` checks them against the real answers of the server and writes the web types from them (`web/src/lib/api.generated.ts`). A type is a TypeScript expression; `optional` fields may be absent.

Connection.doc: The link with an installation's WebServer (or its node).

AirQuality.doc: Air quality, for thermostats with a sensor.

fields.name: level
fields.doc: null while the sensor gives no measure.

fields.name: value
fields.doc: Value read from the WebServer.

fields.name: mode
fields.doc: Air purification.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: Name to display (Breezone custom name, else the Airzone name).

fields.name: modes
fields.doc: Modes available on this zone's system.

fields.name: demand
fields.doc: The zone is currently asking for heat or cold.

fields.name: air_quality
fields.doc: Thermostats with an air quality sensor only.

NodeRef.doc: The node an installation is reached through.

InstallationUserRights.doc: What a user may change on an installation, besides driving it.

fields.name: zones
fields.doc: Zone names and groups.

fields.name: schedules
fields.doc: Airzone schedules.

fields.name: admin
fields.doc: The installation's own settings (address, Airzone link, deletion).

Installation.doc: An Airzone installation, with its zones.

fields.name: country
fields.doc: Country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2), set by hand.

fields.name: access
fields.doc: "local": WebServer on this server's network; "node": through another Breezone server.

fields.name: controllable
fields.doc: false when read-only (for this user, or shared read-only by its node).

fields.name: rights
fields.doc: What the signed-in user may change on it.

fields.name: record_demand
fields.doc: The time each zone spends in demand is recorded (set on the server that owns it).

Measures.doc: What a "consumption" measure measures: a device, or a room.

DeviceView.doc: A device of the home: an Airzone zone or a device of a module (ADR 0013).

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: Main trait ("climate.zone").

fields.name: traits
fields.doc: `trait@version` the device has.

fields.name: source
fields.doc: Driver that provides it ("airzone", "shelly").

fields.name: reference
fields.doc: Where to find it in its source (Airzone: `{system_id, zone_id}`).

fields.name: available
fields.doc: The source currently provides it (a zone removed from its installation is not).

fields.name: state
fields.doc: Values of its traits (fields described in the catalog).

fields.name: can_control
fields.doc: This user may drive it.

fields.name: icon
fields.doc: Chosen by hand (a Lucide name); null: guessed from the name.
